findings.problem: kit_numstat lists an am patch with apply --numstat in the -C/cwd subdirectory; apply honours that prefix but git am applies from the work-tree top, so the kit set is empty and the verdict is pass
findings.scenario: installed flat repo, format-patch mbox touching .claude/hooks/x: git -C src am m.mbox (or git am m.mbox with cwd src) passes and commits .claude/hooks/x; git am m.mbox from the root denies (G19.007)
findings.closure: for sub == am only, kit_numstat runs apply --numstat from rev-parse --show-toplevel with each relative patch operand joined to the original directory; G19 rows git -C src am m.mbox and git am m.mbox with cwd src deny kit code; G19.005 git -C sub apply still passes

findings.problem: past CONTENTS_ROWS a kit-free contents copy into the project root or .claude/ becomes a kit deny instead of the guarded ask; the verdict flips at 25 entries
findings.scenario: installed, 30 plain files: cp -R big30/. . denies kit code: the project root (base asked guarded path)

findings.problem: same cause as R3-2 in a nested project: a plain-diff mbox run from mono/app is denied as app/.claude/hooks/x while am writes mono/.claude/hooks/x, outside the project
findings.scenario: git am plaintop.mbox from mono/app denies; base passed

findings.problem: with a <branch> the third rebase term must be <branch>...<upstream>, not HEAD...<upstream>
findings.scenario: on h (reverts hook to x), git rebase U s passes and the hook goes from x to k

findings.problem: --onto A...B (merge base form) does not resolve, so the dropped-commits set is silently skipped
findings.scenario: git rebase --onto main...U U passes, hook left at x

findings.problem: kit_set_root raises KitUnread when rev-parse --show-toplevel fails (cwd in .git, bare repo): read-only kit subcommands now ask
findings.scenario: git -C .git stash list asks; base passed

findings.problem: the .claude/worktrees/ exemption roots a nested project's worktree on that worktree's top (a copy of the bigger repo), not on w/app
in a nested project the kit deny/ask reasons show the git-top path (app/.claude/hooks/x), not the project path
findings.scenario: G19.042 reason reads kit code: app/.claude/hooks/x
